fomod.Name: Precision Physic Bodies
fomod.Author: mad72
fomod.Description: A complete rebuild of Skyrim VR's NPC Havok bodies. Joints that track the XP32 skeleton, collision capsules that fit the actual body mesh, both refitted live at runtime. 18 joints and ~148 capsules instead of 19, fitted per NPC by ReScale and ReShape. 2.0: male bodies (human, khajiit, argonian), genital collision with touch-driven erection (SPS/TNG), and a front-neck choking capsule on every skeleton. 2.1: NPC and player collision is suspended for the duration of an OStim scene, which fixes scene alignment; plus quieter contact materials and touch-API fixes.
